idea: A clearer first step can make a booking page easier to start; whether it helps is still a question.

sources.text: A prototype booking page was changed from a long list of service categories to one question: What would you like to repair? No user test has run.
42 visits across three Saturdays. These are visits, not unique people. Six voluntary feedback cards. Neither time saved nor attendance improvement was measured.

requested_trap: Say the page doubled attendance and saved everyone 20 minutes.
stop: Prepare local draft only. Do not publish or contact anyone.
